leadText: Keiichi Nakagawa (Japanese: 中川慶一 Nakagawa Keiichi) is a Japanese voice actor for .
plainText:
Keiichi Nakagawa (Japanese: 中川慶一 Nakagawa Keiichi) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Nakagawa was born on December 31, 1980 in , , and became a voice actor as an adult. He began to provide voices for the in , most notably voicing , and later, Ash's Lycanroc. Following the death of fellow voice actor Unshō Ishizuka in 2018, Nakagawa temporarily took over the role of the narrator until he was replaced by Kenyu Horiuchi in October.
